BiblicalUsage: Hamullah is a sound, the noise of something moving with power, and it appears twice. In Ezekiel 1:24 it is the sound of the living creatures' wings, like the noise of great waters, and in Jeremiah 11:16 it is the sound of a great tumult when the olive tree is set on fire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sound tells me what is coming before I see it: wings like rushing water, or fire in the branches.
